title: Some believe Jed York will "self-suspend," regardless of league action

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Some believe Jed York will "self-suspend," regardless of league action
sources.description: When it comes to the NFL's potential discipline of 49ers owner Jed York for his no-contest plea resulting from an attempt to pay for sex at an Ohio trailer park, the widespread public humiliation (which has crossed the Atlantic Ocean due to his partial ownership of two English soccer clubs) could be punishment enough.
